newsitem.title: USA: GPU's two Pa. coal units back in operation.
newsitem.headline: GPU's two Pa. coal units back in operation.

text.p: GPU Generation Inc said Thursday two coal-fired generation units in Pennsylvania returned to operation after they were shut last weekend for repairs and maintenance.
The 600 megawatt (MW) unit 1 at its Homer City, Pa., power facility resumed service Wednesday after being shut Saturday for maintenance, a GPU spokeswoman said.
The 850 megawatt (MW) Conemaugh 2 coal-fired unit was operating at full output today after being idled Sunday to repair a boiler tube leak, she said.
Pennsylania Electric Co (Penelec) and New York State Electric & Gas Corp each have 50 percent stakes in the Homer City unit 1.
Conemaugh unit 2, in Indiana County, western Pennsylvania, is jointly owned by utility members of the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland Interconnect power pool.
Both Penelec and GPU Generation, which operates the Homer City and Conemaugh facilities, are subsidiaries of General Public Utilities Corp of Parisippany, N.J.
